why: Both cover joking talk in the room and a single isolated merry reaction like 'triggered' could be read either as the room's own in-joke or as a taunt at a rival without more context.

why.T3-031: Summoning a bot with a set trigger phrase and explaining its words is the room's running meme/catchphrase played in talk, not an April Fools fake, a taunt at a rival, or an explanation of the canvas event.

why.T3-002: The material is the room's call to make a Frog on the canvas answered inside with a brief 'Wat'; it sits on the call-for-hands side, not on any defence, doubt or refusal.

why.T3-082: Members are checking who made a flag already shown on the canvas, exactly the finding-the-room's-mark-placed move of pointing to it and asking who made it; it is not a belonging dispute nor a voice-for-the-room dispute.

why.T3-031: A greeting traded under the finished image through the room's own spelling joke is the room's running meme played among members, not a greeting to another room nor a claim of victory.

why.T3-001: The room produces and posts its own April Fools content for the day (a joke cover announced as ending April 1st and published), the members making their own April Fools matter rather than reacting to a maker's joke.
why.T3-064: Three concepts carry the room's April Fools joke beyond the sub into r/LoveLiveCovers (asking to repost with credit, posting it themselves, thanking for the cross-post reminder), which T3-001's gate does not reach.

multiplacement_log.why_not_one: Placing only on T3-001 would leave the room's carrying of its joke into another sub unrecorded: the repost request, the self-post to r/LoveLiveCovers and the thanks for the cross-post reminder are acts pointed outward at another community.
multiplacement_log.why_this_one: Members carry the room's own April Fools cover into another sub and site, which is exactly T3-064's gate of taking the room's joke elsewhere; its distinct supporting concepts are the repost request and self-posting.
multiplacement_log.dispensable: T3-064, if forced to one; what would be lost is the record that the joke was carried outward as well as staged.

why.T3-095: The material notices a change made by another room (the Jazz sub), the sort of outside April Fools claim or change members register, not the company's own joke and not this room's takeover.

why.T3-024: The concept states keeping off others' art and protecting it instead, which is the room's own restraint toward neighbours' work, contrasted against expansion; it is not taking space (T3-061) or destroying a rival (T3-006).

why.T3-031: A bare 'T R I G G E R E D' reaction with no rival named and no canvas work described is the room's own joking refrain played in talk, rather than a taunt at a named community or objecting to April Fools posts.
